research.notes: Not publishable. I found no public registry record (CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) and no page tying this shop to OUSD or its workplace training partner program. Identity rests on the name and the Oakland location. The address is copied exactly as the homepage shows it, without a ZIP code. Yelp and Yahoo Local listings give ZIP 94601, but I did not fetch them. The site's only email is a named person's address, so I left email null. Legal entity name, EIN, CA entity number and UEI are unknown. A reviewer should check the CA Secretary of State and the MOU to confirm that this shop is the contracting party.

profile.summary: Auto Works & Company is an auto body and collision repair shop in Oakland, California. It offers collision repair, auto painting, glass replacement, detailing and free estimates for all makes and models. It says it has served Oakland and nearby areas for over 15 years.
